Figures taken from the Albus IB knowledge base v1.0 (compiled August 2026), which paraphrases the official IB subject guides rather than reproducing them. Verify against the current guide before quoting marks to a student.

Guide currency conflict, unresolved: this file follows the knowledge base (7.5), which states the 2017 guide 'applies through May 2027; the new guide is first assessed May 2028.' An official IB subject brief PDF (Nord Anglia mirror, IBO copyright 2015) instead states 'First assessments 2017-last assessments 2025' for the same guide. Not resolved either way -- a student on the wrong side of this date would have the wrong IA criteria. Check directly against a current guide before the 2026-27 school year if this has not been done.
